newsitem.title: USA: Yahoo! touts billion page view quarter.
newsitem.headline: Yahoo! touts billion page view quarter.

text.p: Executives of the Web navigational guide and branded Web media network company Yahoo! Inc said its one billion page views in the third quarter demonstrated potential for the Web advertising model.

"These are users voting with their eyeballs," Gary Valenzuela, senior vice president and chief financial officer of Yahoo! said in a presentation to investors at the Montgomery Securities offfice here.

Santa Clara-based Yahoo! said on Tuesday it had reached a landmark one billion page views for its first quarter ended on September 30 and that its traffic had also increased to an average of 14 million views a day in September.

At the typical $20 per thousand screen views (PCMs) Web advertising payment scale, if Yahoo! were able to fill its advertising spaces completely, it would be capable of generating up to $25 million of revenues in a three-month period.

Valenzuela and Yahoo! president and chief executive Tim Koogle would not discuss third quarter financial results, but industry executives have cautioned that the nascent industry is currently challenged to fill available advertising slots and therefore page views may not translate into ad revenues.
The Yahoo! executives said they expect to report third quarter results on October 9.
In its second quarter to June 30, Yahoo! posted a net loss of$1.36 million, or a $0.05 a share loss, on net revenues of $3.27 million.
